tools.name: vendor-compliance_onboarding-precheck
tools.description: Compare a supplied vendor record, document list, and attestations with the buyer requirements before you onboard or pay a vendor. Missing, expired, failed, and unverified items are reported separately. Call with vendor; optional asOf, projectName, documents, requirements, attestations. HTTP 200 with

tools.name: vendor-compliance_contractor-prequalification
tools.description: Compare buyer qualification criteria with supplied vendor facts, documents, and evidence before you onboard or pay a vendor. The result does not award eligibility or query a registry. Call with vendor and requirements; optional asOf, projectName, documents, evidence. Returns checkedAt, asOf, purpose

tools.name: vendor-compliance_subcontractor-payment-readiness
tools.description: List missing payment documents and caller-supplied open items before you onboard or pay a vendor. This check does not release a payment or rerun sanctions, wage, or certificate screens. Call with requirements; optional asOf, projectName, vendor, documents, openItems. Returns checkedAt, asOf, purpose

tools.name: vendor-compliance_document-completeness
tools.description: Compare a supplied document inventory with a buyer requirements list before you onboard or pay a vendor. Files are not fetched, and a present document is not treated as verified content. Call with documents and requirements; optional asOf, projectName. Returns checkedAt, asOf, purpose, projectName,

tools.name: vendor-compliance_report
tools.description: Consolidate supplied vendor information, documents, attestations, evidence, and open items into one requirements report before you onboard or pay a vendor. External registries are not contacted. Call with optional asOf, projectName, vendor, documents, requirements, attestations and others. HTTP 200

tools.name: vendor-compliance_contractor-closeout-check
tools.description: Compare buyer closeout requirements with supplied documents and attestations before you onboard or pay a vendor. A passing result does not certify that the project is complete.
